mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,enabled,fulfillment_enabled fulfillmentEnabled FROM warehouse WHERE id=CAST(#{warehouseId} AS UNSIGNED) FOR SHARE

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,CAST(warehouse_id AS CHAR) warehouseId,CAST(sku_id AS CHAR) skuId, on_hand onHand,reserved,quarantine,version FROM stock_balance WHERE warehouse_id=CAST(#{warehouseId} AS UNSIGNED) AND sku_id=CAST(#{skuId} AS UNSIGNED) FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,CAST(business_line_id AS CHAR) businessLineId,CAST(warehouse_id AS CHAR) warehouseId, CAST(sku_id AS CHAR) skuId,quantity,state,version FROM stock_reservation WHERE business_type='ORDER' AND business_line_id=CAST(#{businessLineId} AS UNSIGNED) FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(biz_id AS CHAR) businessId,CAST(biz_line_id AS CHAR) businessLineId,CAST(warehouse_id AS CHAR) warehouseId, CAST(sku_id AS CHAR) skuId,delta_reserved quantity FROM stock_ledger WHERE biz_type='ORDER' AND biz_line_id=CAST(#{businessLineId} AS UNSIGNED) AND action='RESERVE' ORDER BY warehouse_id,sku_id,id FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_balance SET reserved=reserved+#{quantity},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) AND version=#{version} AND on_hand-reserved >= #{quantity}
UPDATE stock_balance SET reserved=reserved-#{quantity},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) AND version=#{version} AND reserved >= #{quantity}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_reservation(business_type,business_line_id,warehouse_id,sku_id,quantity,state) VALUES('ORDER',CAST(#{businessLineId} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{warehouseId} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{skuId} AS UNSIGNED),#{quantity},'HELD')
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_reservation SET state='RELEASED',version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) AND business_type='ORDER' AND state='HELD' AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_ledger(biz_type,biz_id,biz_line_id,action,warehouse_id,sku_id, on_hand_before,reserved_before,quarantine_before,in_transit_before, delta_on_hand,delta_reserved,delta_quarantine,delta_in_transit, on_hand_after,reserved_after,quarantine_after,in_transit_after,actor_id,trace_id) VALUES('ORDER',CAST(#{businessId} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{businessLineId} AS UNSIGNED),#{action}, CAST(#{warehouseId} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{skuId} AS UNSIGNED), #{onHand},#{reservedBefore},#{quarantine},0,0,#{deltaReserved},0,0, #{onHand},#{reservedBefore}+#{deltaReserved},#{quarantine},0,CAST(#{actorId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS UNSIGNED),#{traceId})
